sources.title: Anivia Build Guide: The Anivia Encyclopedia | An In-Depth Anivia Guide

passive.name: Rebirth
passive.text: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg and is reborn with full health.

spells.name: Flash Frost
spells.text: Anivia brings her wings together and summons a sphere of ice that flies towards her opponents, chilling and damaging anyone in its path. When the sphere explodes it does moderate damage in a radius, stunning anyone in the area.

spells.name: Crystallize
spells.text: Anivia condenses the moisture in the air into an impassable wall of ice to block all movement. The wall only lasts a short duration before it melts.

spells.name: Frostbite
spells.text: With a flap of her wings, Anivia blasts a freezing gust of wind at her target, dealing damage. If the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm, the damage they take is doubled.

spells.name: Glacial Storm
spells.text: Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail to damage her enemies and slow their advance.

damage.value: Anivia deals bursts of ice damage with Flash Frost and Frostbite, while Glacial Storm damages enemies with a driving rain of ice and hail.

archetype.value: Anivia can play as an enchanter in support with Helia and Diadem.

axis.value: Anivia can poke with Flash Frost, then use Frostbite for doubled damage if Flash Frost recently hit.

winCondition.value: Anivia wins by scaling into the mid and late game.

spikes.why: Anivia gains damage and mana from one item.
Anivia gets a clearer power spike whether she buys either item first.
Anivia gains damage and mana from it, creating an earlier power spike than the Seraph’s build described in the guide.

bait.why: After Anivia spends Flash Frost, its 11-to-7-second cooldown leaves her without its stun and one way to double Frostbite's damage.
After Anivia spends Crystallize, its 17-second cooldown leaves her unable to place another impassable wall.

mistakes.value: Anivia gives up damage until her third item when she builds Seraphs instead of the described Malignance setup.
Rushing Seraph’s on Anivia sacrifices damage until a third-item Liandry’s Torment.
Anivia loses Frostbite's doubled damage by using it without a recent Flash Frost hit or damage from a fully formed Glacial Storm.
